# CK PropFirm Discount Code & Deals History

This dataset tracks historical deal observations for CK PropFirm from PropFirmDiscount.com.

CK PropFirm has no standing discount code. Each offer is a campaign with
its own code, stated on that deal's page in the dataset below.

Prop firm page: https://propfirmdiscount.com/prop-firm/ckcapital/
